summary: Iteration 46 — verified companion-reasons i18n fix (`v2` cache key + stronger LLM prompt). 8/8 backend tests pass. No English pest tokens leak in gd/cy/fr companion reasons. Nasturtium 'aphid' regression (reported bug) is fixed — Gaelic reason now reads 'Bidh nasturtium a\' tharruing dhìobhran-dhubha air falbh bhon tomato agad.' English endpoint still natural. Cache-hit path returns byte-identical body. /api/plants?language=gd returns 300+ plants with no pest-word leaks.

minor.issue: First-hit LLM translation for a fresh language can exceed Cloudflare's ~100s edge timeout (502 origin_bad_gateway on Welsh cold-hit during this run). Origin completes successfully and caches; subsequent hits are instant. Consider (a) warming cache via a background job for supported languages, or (b) returning English placeholder immediately then background-translating.

action_items: Optional: pre-warm guidance_cache for popular language×plant pairs to avoid first-hit CF 502s (LLM call can take >60s on cold Welsh/Gaelic requests).
critical_code_review_comments: core.py::make_translate_companion_reasons — cache key now includes ':v2:' version suffix, good pattern for future prompt bumps. Prompt explicitly enumerates pest / companion / beneficial-insect vocabulary — solid mitigation.

No fallback if LLM returns malformed / partial JSON — if a future prompt regresses, reasons_map lookup silently falls back to the English reason (line 1002-1004). Consider logging when reasons_map is missing an id so future partial-translation regressions are visible in logs.
guidance_cache has no TTL — old v1 rows already purged manually. Consider a background cleanup for :v1: keys, or auto-expire index on `created_at`.
seed_data_creation: None — tests call live endpoints only. First gd/cy call warmed the guidance_cache via LLM; fr was already cached.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Companion-reasons cache key is now `companion-reasons:{lang}:v2:{sorted-ids}`. If prompt/logic changes again, bump to v3 or wipe cache. Cold LLM translation for a new (language, plant) pair can hit Cloudflare's ~100s timeout and return 502 — retry once (origin has usually stored the row by then). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_companion_i18n_iter46.py serves as regression coverage.
